geometry_uncertain.note: vendor_mechanic_tags: impact-burst, hit-spark, collision-flash, strike-effect, physical-impact, force-impact, slash-impact, explosion-impact. impact-burst=impact_burst; hit-spark=impact_burst; collision-flash=nova_radial; strike-effect=melee_strike; physical-impact=melee_strike; force-impact=impact_burst or melee_strike; slash-impact=melee_arc (impact of a slash); explosion-impact=nova_radial. dash_attack inferred: hit-spark/impact types often generated by dash-attack landing.

notes: 44 animations — largest single-pack melee/impact count in the crawl. Exclusively kinetic-impact geometry family. 100x100px canvas. impact_burst and melee_strike are the dominant types. This pack is the Q5-kinetic-anchor for the catalogue — best single source for impact_burst depth. 15 Pixel FX Designer source project files included (editability advantage).

notes: 180 animations (9 effects x 20 variations). Physical-injury/gore register. Primary geometries: impact_burst (blood-impact), nova_radial (blood-splatter), ground_slam_directional (blood-pool forms on ground). Note: blood-pool is an ambient/persistent ground effect — closest to ground_slam_directional (appears at ground position with persistent state). Geometry classification for blood-pool is uncertain: persistent_zone could also apply but is not in the 30-target vocabulary.
